scripts.test: bun test ./scripts ./sandbox && bun test --preload ./src/test/dom.ts ./src && bun run test:agent

scripts.agent:node: CLIENTOPS_SCHEDULER=on LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True AGENT_CALLBACK_URL=http://host.docker.internal:8001 uv run --directory agent python serve.py
scripts.check:agent: LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True uv run --directory agent python -m clientops.check
